About Us

Ridgeway Services & Construction Ltd. is a family-owned commercial construction company with over 30 years of experience delivering quality retail, restaurant, office, and tenant improvement projects. Built on trust, craftsmanship, and strong relationships, we provide reliable construction solutions from concept to completion.

Ridgeway Services & Construction Ltd. is a proud family-owned and operated company with over 30 years of experience in the commercial construction industry. Many of our dedicated team members are family, and that spirit of trust, commitment, and collaboration is reflected in everything we do.

We specialize in Commercial Retail Design, Engineering, and Construction, with a strong focus on working directly with landlords and leasing agents. Our expertise lies in interpreting Landlord Work Schedules within lease agreements and transforming them into detailed scopes of work with accurate cost estimates. This streamlined approach helps expedite lease execution and ensures that all landlord responsibilities are met throughout the construction process.

Our team includes a full-time office staff of 10 and a field staff of 20 experienced professionals—site superintendents, carpenters, framers, drywallers, painters, and general laborers—all highly skilled in retail construction, store fixturing, restaurant builds, office build-outs, and tenant fit-ups.

We handle a wide range of projects, from individual retail stores, restaurants, offices, and daycares to full ground-up construction of new strip plazas and pad site buildings.

Our History

Ridgeway Services & Construction Ltd. began over 30 years ago as a family-run business built on strong values, hard work, and a commitment to quality. Founded with a clear focus on commercial construction, our company has grown steadily—both in size and reputation—while remaining true to its roots.

What started as a small team has evolved into a full-service operation with over 30 dedicated professionals, including site superintendents, skilled tradespeople, and a strong office support staff. Many of our team members are family, and that close-knit foundation has helped us foster long-standing relationships with clients, landlords, and leasing agents alike.

Over the decades, we've carved out a niche in commercial retail design, engineering, and construction—handling everything from tenant fit-ups and office build-outs to restaurants, daycares, and full ground-up strip plaza developments. We specialize in interpreting complex lease agreements and landlord work schedules, translating them into clear scopes of work and ensuring smooth, cost-effective execution from start to finish.

As the industry has evolved, so have we—growing our capabilities while maintaining the same personalized service and hands-on approach that set us apart from day one. Today, Ridgeway continues to be a trusted partner in commercial construction, known for quality, reliability, and a strong commitment to getting the job done right.
